reason: Provides a desktop-oriented standalone app window for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with automatic and manual opening, persisted settings, and browser-process lifecycle controls.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 以独立桌面应用窗口打开，并提供自动开窗、手动切换和启动设置。
summaries.en: Opens the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in a standalone desktop app window with automatic launch, manual toggling, and startup settings.

capabilities: Launches Edge or Chrome in standalone app-window mode
Starts and manages a dedicated browser window process
Persists an auto-open setting under the DSH home directory
Provides same-origin HTTP routes for window control
Uses Windows process and PowerShell helpers for lifecycle and icon handling
